headline: The Ogra (Amendment) Bill, 2026, introduced in the Senate on Friday, proposes quarterly revision of gas sale prices, with no public hearing for these revisions, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Ogra amendment bill seeks quarterly gas prices without public hearings.

caption:
A bill introduced in the Senate on Friday proposes revising gas prices every quarter, Dawn reports. Under the Ogra (Amendment) Bill, 2026, the federal government would advise sale prices for each consumer category within 30 days of Ogra's advice, and no public hearing would be held for these revisions.
